The P2 edge connector is drawn only as an outline with its ends marked Z (left) and A (right); no contact is named. NOTES: 1. LEGEND: circle = CONNECTOR PIN MOUNTED ON SOLDER SIDE; circle with ring = STAND OFF (No. 461-03-015) MOUNTED ON PIN; oval = PAD PROVIDED FOR WIRING. 2. USE PCB No. 4-136. 3. ALL IC's LM201 N. '461-03-015' in the file name is the stand-off part number from the legend, not a drawing number. The picture itself names no module.
